items.title: Bulls return to D-St! Sensex zooms 2,000 points intraday; key factors here
items.description: Analysts said that the dramatic change in FII stance towards India, AI trade unwinding, rupee appreciation, and better-than-expected earnings growth have combined to boost market sentiment.

items.title: Stock Market Close: Sensex surges 1,502 pts, Nifty ends at 25,819; Nifty FMCG rises 3.8%

items.title: Nifty FMCG index soars 3%; Dabur, Godrej Consumer, HUL rally up to 8%
items.description: The Nifty FMCG index was the top gainer among sectoral indices up 3.18%, compared to a 1.66% rise in the Nifty 50 on Wednesday.

items.title: NSE jumps 5% to new high on ICICI Sec's 'buy' call; target signals 20% rise
items.description: ICICI Securities said that India's capital market is a multi-decade growth story, and NSE could be one of its biggest beneficiaries. The brokerage has set the NSE share price target at ₹2,650.

items.title: PL Capital ups Nifty target to 28,561 on earnings growth, valuation comfort
items.description: Amnish Aggarwal, Co-Head - Institutional Equities, PL Capital, said that while near-term volatility cannot be ruled out, we remain cautiously optimistic over the next 12-15 months.

items.title: Haldyn Glass share price zooms 10% on acquiring Heinz Glas's stake in JV
items.description: Haldyn Glass in an exchange filing on Wednesday said it completed the acquisition of Heinz Glas's entire 43.2 per cent stake in its joint venture Haldyn Heinz Fine Glass.

items.title: Gold's retreat deepens as US Fed fears push prices back towards $3,500
items.description: For gold, the challenge is not simply the next rate hike but the prospect of a prolonged higher-for-longer policy regime.

items.title: L&T jumps over 2% on ₹2,500 crore battery storage project win in Gujarat
items.description: Larsen & Toubro's order has been jointly won by its Renewables business and L&T Electronic Products & Systems.

items.title: Welspun Living up 110% YTD; MOFSL bets on capex-led growth, sees 18% upside
items.description: Motilal Oswal Financial Services said that the fresh investments are expected to strengthen its cost competitiveness, improve supply-chain reliability and support margin expansion.

items.title: Sharp November run-up dims mkt's risk-reward ratio; volatility likely: KIE
items.description: The Indian equity markets have surged 10 per cent so far in November as foreign investors returned to Dalal Street with full force, ploughing in a record ₹1.3 trillion in this month so far.

items.title: Block deal impact: Piramal Pharma down 7% on trades of 100 mn shares on BSE
items.description: At 09:15 AM on Wednesday, around 100.18 million equity shares (7.52 per cent of Piramal Pharma's total equity) changed hands on the BSE, the exchange data shows.

items.title: Oil-sensitive stocks rally up to 5% as Brent slips below $90; CEAT leads
items.description: Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, was trading 1.54 per cent lower at $89.99 per barrel, while West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude fell 1.7 per cent to $80.60.

items.title: Thomas Cook shares rally 14%, soar 62% in a month; what's driving gains?
items.description: Thomas Cook shares have delivered a stellar performance over the past month, surging 62 per cent, even as the benchmark Nifty 50 index declined nearly 1 per cent.

items.title: Gold, Silver in focus: Tech analyst decodes charts of Gold, Silver ETFs
items.description: Drumil Vithlani, Senior Technical Research Analyst at Tiny Epic believes that Nippon India ETF Gold BeES and Nippon India Silver ETF remain in a multi-year uptrend despite the recent sell-off.

items.title: Ventive Hospitality shares gain 5% on growth plans; MOFSL sees 29% upside
items.description: According to the investor presentation by the company, Ventive Hospitality is looking to double its operating EBITDA to ₹2,000-2,200 crore by FY31.

items.title: ICICI Bank rallies 4%, hits all-time high; market cap nears ₹12 trillion
items.description: ICICI Bank's share price hit a new life-time high of ₹1,647 in Wednesday's intraday trade, and its market capitalisation rose to ₹11.8 trillion. The stock gained 18% thus far in November.

items.title: Railway stock: Jupiter Wagons climbs 12% after 8-day fall on JV with Woojin
items.description: Jupiter Wagons has announced that it will manufacture metro trains and propulsion systems in India through a joint venture with Korea's Woojin Industrial Systems.

items.title: Asian stocks tumble as AI rebound stumbles, US tariff threats loom
items.description: MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan was ​down 3.2%, led by a drop of as much as 6.4% in South Korean shares and an ​8.6% decline at the worst point in Taiwan

items.title: Insurance stocks in demand: PB Fintech, Max Life, HDFC Life rally up to 8%
items.description: Motilal Oswal maintained a positive stance toward the insurance sector's value of new business (VNB) margin expansion, backed by a rising share of non-ULIP products and improving cost efficiency.
